title: My family
summary: Xiaoyu introduces her family and what everyone does.

sentences.en: My name is Xiaoyu. I'm ten this year.

sentences.zh: 我家有五口人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥、妹妹和我。
sentences.en: There are five people in my family: Dad, Mum, my older brother, my younger sister and me.

sentences.zh: 我爸爸是医生，他在医院工作。
sentences.en: My dad is a doctor; he works at a hospital.

sentences.zh: 我妈妈是老师，她在一个小学工作。
sentences.en: My mum is a teacher; she works at a primary school.
Mum and Dad are both very busy at work.

sentences.zh: 我哥哥是大学生，他很喜欢学习。
sentences.en: My older brother is a university student; he loves studying.

sentences.zh: 我妹妹五岁，她很喜欢猫。
sentences.en: My younger sister is five; she really likes cats.
In the evening we all eat at home.

questions.prompt: How many people are in Xiaoyu's family?
why: Count again: Dad, Mum, brother, sister and Xiaoyu make five.
The text says 五口人 — five.
Her older brother is the university student.
The text doesn't say Mum likes cats.
Her brother studies at university; nothing about cats.

questions.prompt: Where does the family eat in the evening?
why: Right: 晚上我们都在家吃饭.
They eat at home, not at a restaurant.
